features.name: any_comment_quotes_op
features.definition: Does at least one counter-argument comment explicitly quote the OP's own title or argument wording?
features.spec: Parse OC_comments (JSON list of other users' comments). Return 1 if at least one comment explicitly quotes the OP's wording from title or argument (verbatim or near-verbatim text, e.g. in quotation marks or blockquote '>' lines, matching OP's text). Return 0 if no comment does so (including empty list). Quotes of other sources or other users do not count. Paraphrase without reproducing OP wording does not count. Ignore OP view-change/delta-award announcements or outcome reports as evidence. Missing or malformed OC_comments, title or argument: null.

features.name: any_comment_paraphrases_op
features.definition: Does at least one counter-argument comment restate the OP's view in its own words without quoting the OP's wording?
features.spec: Parse OC_comments. Return 1 if at least one comment explicitly restates or summarizes the OP's claim/argument from title or argument in its own words (paraphrase, not reproducing OP wording in quotes or blockquote). Return 0 if none does (including empty list). Ignore OP view-change/delta-award announcements or outcome reports as evidence. Missing or malformed inputs: null.

h0: any_comment_quotes_op is not associated with probability of view change (delta) when controlling for any_comment_paraphrases_op.
h1: any_comment_quotes_op is associated with a higher probability of view change than its absence, controlling for any_comment_paraphrases_op.
note: Operational assumption: "quote rather than paraphrase" is measured at discussion level as presence of quoting, with paraphrase presence as a covariate; the coefficient is not an exact quote-vs-paraphrase contrast (overlap and neither cases preserved). Quoting is judged against current title/argument, which may include edits or outcome announcements (excluded semantically). Comment order and timing unknown; OC_comments may include comments after the view change. Associations only.
